title: Capacity scenarios
description: Compare dates and assignments before changing the official plan.
forbidden: You do not have access to capacity planning.
emptyNote: Start from current capacity, adjust a task or add hypothetical project work, then compare the impact.
createNote: Creates a private draft from your current planning access. Official tasks stay unchanged until you review and apply selected changes.
name: Scenario name
stale: The official plan or availability changed. Refresh the draft before editing or applying; this discards its proposed changes.
appliedNote: {{count}} selected tasks were updated. Other proposed changes and hypothetical work were not applied. This comparison preserves the original draft.
method: Estimates are spread across calendar days in Monday–Sunday UTC weeks. Absences remove the corresponding fraction of weekly availability, with overlapping days counted once. Logged hours are not deducted. Missing data means the projection is incomplete; it does not guarantee a delivery date.
hidden: Some work is outside your access. Its details are hidden and remaining capacity is unknown.
parents: {{count}} parent tasks are excluded from totals; only tasks without subtasks contribute workload.
unassigned: {{count}} items have no active assignee. Remaining capacity stays unknown.
memberLimit: Showing the first 100 people. Filter by person to see others.
noChanges: Add a task change or hypothetical work to compare its impact.
proposalOnly: Simulation only. This workload will not create a project or task when applying the draft.
confirmApply: I reviewed the selected tasks. Apply their dates and assignees and close this draft. Unselected changes stay unapplied.
resetNote: Refreshing replaces the base with the current plan and clears all proposed changes. Deleting removes this draft. Neither action changes official tasks.
confirmReset: I agree to discard the proposed changes.
moveNote: Changes stay in this draft until explicitly applied. Assignees need access to the project. Moving dates does not resolve task dependencies.
absenceNote: Full-day absences affect the official capacity view. Dates are inclusive in UTC, up to 367 days per entry. Overlaps count once. Scenarios created earlier must refresh their base to include changes. Correct an entry by removing it and adding the replacement.

errors.FAILED: Could not complete this action. Reload and try again.
errors.PLAN_CHANGED: The plan changed. Refresh the base and review a new draft before applying.
errors.VERSION_CHANGED: This draft changed in another request. Reload before trying again.
errors.SCENARIO_ACCESS_CHANGED: Some original tasks are no longer available to you. Refresh the base to build a new draft from your current access.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the fields, date order and limits, then try again.
errors.PROJECT_ACCESS_REQUIRED: Choose an active person who can access this project.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This person is no longer an active member. Reload the list.
errors.TASK_UNAVAILABLE: This task is not part of the available base. Reload the scenario.
errors.INVALID_SELECTION: Select saved changes to existing tasks only.
errors.REQUEST_CONFLICT: This request was already saved with different content. Reload and review it.
errors.SCENARIO_LIMIT: You have reached 100 saved scenarios. Delete an unused draft first.
errors.ABSENCE_LIMIT: The organization has reached 2,000 absence entries. Remove obsolete entries before adding more.
errors.TEAM_TOO_LARGE: This view supports up to 500 active members.
errors.PLAN_TOO_LARGE: Scenarios support up to 2,000 projects and 2,000 open tasks per organization.

scrollComparison: Scroll horizontally to compare the base plan, scenario and remaining capacity.
